title: oxalis calcaria
intro: Oxalis calcaria, commonly known as the rough-leaf wood sorrel, is a species of flowering plant in the wood sorrel family, Oxalidaceae. The health benefits of Oxalis calcaria include its use in treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, due to its anti-inflammatory and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Oxalis calcaria include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
